itinerary.title: Tawang – Bomdila
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive back over Sela Pass to Bomdila (about 6 hrs). Visit the Bomdila monastery and local market. Overnight stay in Bomdila.

itinerary.title: Bomdila – Guwahati Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Guwahati (about 8 hrs). Drop at the airport or railway station for an evening departure – flights after 6 pm recommended. Tour ends.
